title: GSQ: Highly-Accurate Low-Precision Scalar Quantization for LLMs via Gumbel-Softmax Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2604.18556v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Quantization has become a standard tool for efficient LLM deployment, especially for local inference, where models are now routinely served at 2-3 bits per parameter. The state of the art is currently split into simple scalar quantization techniques, such as GPTQ or AWQ, which are widely deployed but plateau in accuracy at 3-4 bits per parameter (bpp), and "second-generation" vector- or trellis-quantized methods, such as QTIP, GPTVQ and AQLM, which push the accuracy frontier but are notoriously hard to implement and to scale. In this paper, we ask whether this gap is fundamental, or whether a carefully optimized $\textit{scalar}$ quantizer can recover most of it. We answer in the affirmative, by introducing GSQ (Gumbel-Softmax Quantization), a post-training scalar quantization method which jointly learns the per-coordinate grid assignments and the per-group scales using a Gumbel-Softmax relaxation of the discrete grid. translated_title: GSQ：通过Gumbel-Softmax采样实现大语言模型的高精度低比特标量量化
translated_abstract: 量化已成为高效部署大语言模型（LLM）的标准工具，尤其在本地推理场景中，模型通常以每参数2-3比特的精度进行服务。目前最先进的技术分为两大阵营：一类是简单的标量量化技术（如GPTQ或AWQ），它们被广泛部署但精度在每参数3-4比特时趋于瓶颈；另一类是“第二代”向量或网格量化方法（如QTIP、GPTVQ和AQLM），它们虽能推动精度上限，但在实现和扩展方面非常困难。本文探究这一差距是否是根本性的，或者一个经过精心优化的标量量化器能否挽回其中大部分差距。我们给出了肯定的答案，提出了GSQ（Gumbel-Softmax量化），这是一种训练后标量量化方法，它利用离散网格的Gumbel-Softmax松弛来联合学习逐坐标的网格分配和逐组的缩放因子。GSQ的性能可以匹敌……
tldr: 提出了GSQ这一训练后标量量化方法，利用Gumbel-Softmax松弛联合学习逐坐标网格分配与逐组缩放因子，使简单的标量量化在低比特精度下就能达到与复杂的第二代向量量化方法相当的高准确率。
en_tdlr: GSQ is a post-training scalar quantization method that jointly learns per-coordinate grid assignments and per-group scales via Gumbel-Softmax relaxation, enabling simple scalar quantization to match the accuracy of complex second-generation vector quantization methods at low bit precision.
